scope: independent root audit of the rank-two strongly generated filtered Frobenius construction, graded Hasse coordinate, isocrystal blindness, residue unipotent product, pointwise support bound, Teichmueller carry, and zero booking

mathematical_audit.filtered_module: With Fil^1=W e1, phi1(e1)=e1+q e2, phi0(e1)=p phi1(e1), and phi0(e2)=e2, the divided images have determinant one and strongly generate M.
mathematical_audit.full_Frobenius: The full matrix [[p,0],[p q,1]] has determinant p and characteristic polynomial (X-p)(X-1), so it is invertible after p is inverted and its semisimple isocrystal data are independent of q.
mathematical_audit.graded_Hasse: Reducing phi1(e1) and projecting to M/(Fil^1+pM) gives multiplication by q. Taking q=Q0 realizes the actual transverse divisor exactly without making the full Frobenius singular.
mathematical_audit.minimality: In rank one, either the Fil^1 source or the complementary graded target is zero. Rank two is minimal for this specific nontrivial scalar graded-Hasse architecture.
mathematical_audit.unipotent_product: The identity U(x)U(y)=U(x+y) turns Item369's additive local moment into an invertible residue-level product U(Q0), genuinely escaping the full-determinant product obstruction.
mathematical_audit.support: Factoring R(x) gives zero-count upper bounds 4, 2(p-1), and 2|h-s| for its three nonmonomial factors. Thus at least p^2-1-[4+2(p-1)+2|h-s|] factors are nonidentity, which is p^2-O(p) on actual rows.
mathematical_audit.horizontal_neutrality: Every residue q admits the same fixed-rank and fixed-Hodge construction, and all q have the same full characteristic polynomial. The rowwise object therefore inserts rather than constrains Q0.
mathematical_audit.lift_scope: Naive Teichmueller lifts are not additive and declared rows exhibit nonzero first carries. This does not rule out a structured Witt or crystalline extension lift.
mathematical_audit.capacity: No prime-independent horizontal family or distribution theorem is constructed. The 1/36 fixed-j1 ceiling and booking zero remain unchanged.
